# lettermint Provider

Manages domains and inbound routes in Lettermint through the Team API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    lettermint = {
      source = "dreamabout/lettermint"
    }
  }
}

# The token is read from LETTERMINT_TOKEN when not set here.
provider "lettermint" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Team API base URL. Defaults to the LETTERMINT_BASE_URL environment variable, or https://api.lettermint.co/v1.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Team API token (lm_team_…). Defaults to the LETTERMINT_TOKEN environment variable.
